ev.q: During 2011–2014, on average, 7.3% of boys’ and 7.2% of girls’ total daily calories were obtained from SSBs
National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, United States, 2011–2014

methods_quotes.q: With 95% confidence intervals indicated with error bars.
Percentage of daily kilocalories from SSBs is calculated as a percent of total daily calories based on Day 1, 24-hour dietary intake data.
